title: Lay It Down
original_lyrics:
[verse]
Ruby red, her lips were on fire
Do me with kiss if you please
Tell me what your sweet heart desires
Tell he how you want it to be
'Cause if it's love you want then you won't mind
little tenderness that sometimes is so hard to find
(Lay it down)
Lay it down - make it alright
(Lay it down)
Lay it down - hold you so tight
(Lay it down)
Ohh, before moment light
Is goin' to be alright
Ohh - lay it down

[chorus]
Tell me how you feel when we make love
Tell me is it real or just make believe
You will never know what you're made of
'Till you open up your heart to receive
'Cause if the love you gots that same old crime
We're talkin' tenderness that's so hard to find
And I'm here to remind you
(Lay it down)
Lay it down - make it alright
(Lay it down)
Lay it down - hold you so tight
(Lay it down)
Yeah, before moment light
Is goin' to be alright
Ohh - lay it down

[chorus]
You remember the times
Talkin' in your sleep
With body full of promise you never gonna keep
From your best friend's lover
You dreamt to find man
When you're pullin' under covers the voices in your head sayin'
If you want it bad
You don't never let it slip away
'Cause if it's love you want then tenderness
(Lay it down)
Lay it down - make it alright
(Lay it down)
Lay it down - hold you so tight
(Lay it down)
Ohh, before moment light
Is goin' to be alright
Ohh - lay it down
Gonna lay it down tonight

[bridge]
You gotta lay it down
